headline: Godcrofts Cleared as Palantine Berm Swings to Wardens
war_summary:
The lines have shifted since the last edition. Palantine Berm, which stood four Colonial works against three Warden at midday, now reads four Warden to three Colonial with nothing unclaimed; Vendett and Windburn Landing remain its busiest ground, though the region's forty-four actions of the day have slowed to a pair in the last two hours. Godcrofts has swept its neutral ground clean — nine works, all Colonial — after a burst of thirty-five actions in six hours about Isawa, Fleecewatch and Ursa Base, easing to four. Marban Hollow holds at four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, with Checkpoint Bua still the chief scene. Weathered Expanse likewise holds six Warden and three unclaimed, its thirty-four actions of the day gone quiet in the past two hours. Linn Mercy stands eight Colonial, two Warden and one neutral, inactive since midday.

The heaviest killing is at Callahan's Passage, where two hours brought nearly fifteen hundred Colonial and a thousand Warden casualties, both accelerating. The Dead Lands report the sharper Warden toll, some twelve hundred in the same span. The victory mark remains thirty-four towns.
